items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Manuel taught it to, to Emmett

ctx.x: They, play it three ways now. Yeah. Uh, well, uh, and he taught, Manuel taught it to, to Emmett, and Emmett's the only one, the only white man that I ever heard that plays right, exactly the way, uh, Manuel, because Manuel at that time was on the boat, you know, with, with fate. He was, all, he was playing melliform on the boat.
And, uh, you know, he told me, uh, Red Allen stole Emmett Hardy's book, that he wrote it out for him. Yeah, he, he did. He stole it and got that part.
